title: polhillides velutina var. sikkimensis
intro: Polhillides velutina var. sikkimensis, commonly known as Himalayan polhillia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Polhillides velutina var. sikkimensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
